# PRWP Reproducibility Review — Project Instructions

The project instructions for every agent are in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the root of this
repository. Read that file in full before doing anything and follow it as your own instructions:
the five skills in `.agents/skills/` (run in order, 1 to 5), where outputs are saved, how changes
to the package are tracked, the final AI use summary, and the key rules.

This file is kept short on purpose so the two do not drift apart.
